title: Home insurance or utility provider comparison
description: Normalize competing quotes onto comparable fields, compare coverage and rates, and score overall value.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: home-utility-insurance-comparison
  title: Home insurance or utility provider comparison
  description: Normalize competing quotes onto comparable fields, compare coverage and rates, and score overall value.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Help a household pick between home insurance or utility quotes with a clear, evidence-based value score.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Quotes and coverage requirements
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions, including the raw quotes or offers being compared and any must-have coverage or service requirements. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: normalize-quotes
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize quotes to comparable fields
      config: { operation: select, expression: "normalize each quote to plan name, monthly or annual rate, coverage limits or service terms, deductible or fees, and contract length" }
    - id: comparator
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Coverage and rate comparator
      role: Comparator analyzing normalized insurance or utility quotes for coverage and rate differences.
      prompt: Compare the normalized quotes side by side on rate, coverage limits or service levels, deductibles or fees, and contract length, and highlight material differences the household should weigh. Note any field missing from a quote rather than guessing a value. State that quoted rates and terms can change and should be confirmed directly with the provider, or with a licensed insurance agent for insurance products, before signing anything.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: value-score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Overall value score
      role: Independent evaluator scoring value for money across compared quotes.
      prompt: Score each quote's overall value by balancing price against coverage or service quality and contract flexibility, given the household's stated requirements. Return a score and passed flag per quote along with the specific reasons for the ranking. Note this is informational only and final terms should be confirmed with the provider before committing.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Ranked comparison with value score
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: normalize-quotes, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: normalize-quotes, to: comparator, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: comparator, to: value-score, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: value-score, to: result, kind: data }
